title: Scenic Trails of Japan with Nagano
alt: Hot spring village under snow in Nagano, Japan
transport: Bullet trains, private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Disneyland
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Super deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, a short walk from the station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and the temple lanes of Asakusa.

activities.name: Mount Fuji, Hakone and Gotemba outlets
activities.match: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi in Hakone and a shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets on the way back.

activities.name: Tokyo Disneyland
activities.description: A full day at Tokyo Disneyland with your admission tickets included, so you can be at the gates when the park opens.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Four nights in Shinjuku with a guided city day, Mount Fuji with the Gotemba outlets and a day at Disneyland.

stops.name: Nagano
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Deluxe room · 3★ · Mountain hotel at Nozawa Onsen, with hot spring baths

activities.name: Snow monkeys, Zenkoji temple and a sake tasting
activities.match: Snow Monkeys, Zenkoji Temple & Sake Day Trip
activities.description: The macaques bathing at Jigokudani, Nagano's great Zenkoji temple and a tasting at one of the valley's old sake breweries.

program.name: Nagano
program.description: Two nights in the mountains at Nozawa Onsen, with a quiet arrival day and the snow monkeys, Zenkoji and sake the next.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel opposite Shin-Osaka station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Osaka walking tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through Dotonbori, the Kuromon market and the lanes around Shinsekai with a guide who knows where to eat.

activities.name: Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji and the deer park at Nara, then the bamboo grove at Arashiyama with a ride on the open sided Sagano scenic train.

activities.name: Sakura Magic and Nabana no Sato illumination
activities.match: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Tour
activities.description: Blossom gardens by day and then Nabana no Sato after dark, where millions of lights are strung into tunnels and fields.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights in Osaka with a walking tour, a day through Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama, and the Nabana no Sato lights.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Eleven days with a mountain village in the middle. The two nights at Nozawa Onsen are what people remember.
expert.tip: Nozawa has thirteen free public baths through the village. Walk between a few in the evening with a small towel, it is a local ritual.

summary: Eleven days with a mountain break in the middle: four nights in Shinjuku with a city day, Mount Fuji and Disneyland, two at Nozawa Onsen for the snow monkeys and a sake tasting, then four in Osaka with Kyoto, Nara, Arashiyama and the Nabana no Sato lights.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast, including a mountain hotel at Nozawa Onsen; bullet trains throughout; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Mount Fuji fifth station with Hakone and the Gotemba outlets; Tokyo Disneyland tickets; snow monkeys, Zenkoji temple and sake day trip; Osaka walking tour; Kyoto and Nara tour with Arashiyama and the Sagano train; Sakura Magic and Nabana no Sato tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
